cues: With a four hundred and eighty hertz fork, l one is seventeen centimetres and l two fifty three.
So lambda is two times thirty six centimetres, zero point seven two metres, and the speed of sound is four eighty times zero point seven two: three hundred and forty five point six metres per second.
The end correction is fifty three minus fifty one, over two: one centimetre.
So the tube's radius is about one point seven centimetres.
